articles.title: Why I'm still bearish on LLMs after Navier-Stokes
articles.zh: 为什么在 Navier-Stokes 之后我依然看空 LLM
articles.summary: 如果你被"LLM 攻克数学难题"的新闻刷屏，这篇泼了盆冷水，讲清楚这为什么没改变他对 LLM 的判断
articles.body:
[ thank you to claude fable 5.1, holden saberhagen, gabriel kammer, andres erbsen, alice mckean, and tristan wylde-larue for comments on this post ]

i'll begin with a few theses for the reader to chew on:

taken together, it appears that for most domains LLMs will continue to look like a cracked intern: quick and effective in the hands of an adult but not given run of the place. most firms will not be able to adopt fully autonomous AI, not for problems of skill issue or lagging technology diffusion but rather for structural reasons seemingly endemic to current architectures. the classes of firms that can accept the use of fully autonomous LLMs are few, by my count just three:

the first two classes are price sensitive and arguably don't need the jump in reasoning quality you see going from cheap to frontier models. most of these firms will be best served by open models running on cheap hardware, perhaps even locally at the site of use. for the first and third classes, the type of fuzzy combinatorial search that has produced headline results in mathematics and security research seems more sensitive to agentic swarm width than reasoning capacity: see small open models reproducing the mythos CVEs that drove the spring 2026 hype cycle. if that is indeed true, there is even greater reason to use cheap open models that enable you to run the same workload with wider swarms.

the third class of firms might still use frontier models, though it's not totally clear that their work couldn't be done with cheap models like deepseek v4.1 flash, and the swarm width advantage i hypothesized above gives them all the more reason to push for cheaper models. another interesting property of firms of this class is that they are generally very secretive about their IP and probably aren't overjoyed about shipping it all to anthropic and openai even with supposed agreements to not train on user data .

now, you might propose that even if the frontier labs are cooked, the data center full of brainlets scenario drives just as much AI compute as an artificial superintelligence scenario. the difference is that the data center full of geniuses is self-driving and limited only by how much compute it can consume while the brainlet swarms will be heavily bottlenecked by their human orchestrators. my personal bet is that the blast radius will go far beyond the frontier labs.
articles.bodyZh:
感谢claude fable 5.1、holden saberhagen、gabriel kammer、andres erbsen、alice mckean和tristan wylde-larue对本文的评论。

我先抛几个观点，供大家琢磨琢磨：

综合来看，对于大多数领域，大语言模型（LLM）看起来会一直像那种“有点疯但能力很强的实习生”：在成年人手里用起来又快又有效，但还不足以让它独当一面、掌控全局。大多数公司没法真正用上完全自主的AI——不是因为技术不够强或者技术扩散太慢，而是因为当前架构里似乎存在一些结构性的、根深蒂固的问题。能接受完全自主LLM的公司类型很少，我数了数，大概就三类：

前两类公司对价格很敏感，而且可以说它们并不需要从廉价模型升级到前沿模型所带来那种推理质量上的飞跃。这些公司大多数情况下，用开源模型跑在便宜硬件上就是最优解，甚至可以直接在本地、在使用现场部署。对于第一类和第三类公司来说，那种在数学和网络安全研究中出了不少大新闻的模糊组合搜索（fuzzy combinatorial search），似乎更依赖于智能体集群（agentic swarm）的规模宽度，而不是推理能力本身——你看那些小型开源模型就能复现出2026年春季炒作周期里那些神话级CVE（通用漏洞披露），就是明证。如果这个判断没错，那就更有理由用便宜的开源模型了，因为这样你就能用更宽的集群来跑同样的工作量。

第三类公司可能还是会用前沿模型，不过说实话，他们的活儿到底能不能用像deepseek v4.1 flash这样的便宜模型搞定，还真不太好说。而我上面假设的那个集群宽度优势，就更让他们有理由去推动使用更便宜的模型了。这类公司还有一个有意思的特点：它们通常对自己的知识产权（IP）极其保密，估计也不太乐意把自己的东西全都打包送给Anthropic和OpenAI，哪怕对方嘴上说不会拿用户数据去训练模型。

你可能会说，就算前沿实验室完蛋了，那个“数据中心里塞满小笨蛋”的场景，消耗的AI算力也不比“人工超级智能”的场景少啊。区别在于：数据中心里塞满天才的话，它是自驱动的，唯一限制就是它能消耗多少算力；而小笨蛋集群则会被它们的人类指挥官严重卡脖子。我个人赌的是，这件事的冲击范围会远远超出前沿实验室。

articles.title: AI for Science with GPT-6 Astra: Thermal Design and Electrothermal Analysis of 2D CFET
articles.zh: GPT-6 Astra 用于科学计算：2D CFET 的热设计与电热分析
articles.summary: 如果你关心 LLM 能不能真下场做芯片级工程仿真，这篇是 GPT-6 Astra 在二维 CFET 电热分析上的实操案例
articles.author: Min-Hui Kim, Khushi Sharma 等
articles.body: Thermal optimization of 2D CFET inverters requires testing structural proposals against their electrical costs. We examine these research tasks using an AI agent workflow within a supplied electrothermal model. At 12 nm, Astra selects a redistributed source-interconnect geometry, while a coordinating agent proposes a substrate-directed heat-removal path. The combined design reduces peak temperature rise by 1.67 K at fixed metal volume and 20 μW. A subsequent metal-resistance sensitivity gives about 0.6-K inverter cooling alongside a 2% nFET on-current loss. Effective contact-length scaling further shows that lower temperature can accompany higher thermal resistance when current falls. Reproduction identifies agreeing implementations and retains a 104.95-K failure for diagnosis. These results show that an AI scientist workflow can propose thermal structures, test them under common constraints, and quantify their electrical cost.
articles.bodyZh: 要给二维 CFET（2D complementary field-effect transistor，互补场效应晶体管）反相器做热优化（thermal optimization），就得把各种结构方案拿出来测一测，看看它们在电学上要付出多大代价。我们用一个 AI 智能体工作流（AI agent workflow），在给定的电热模型（electrothermal model）里来研究这些任务。到了 12 纳米（nm）节点，Astra 选了一种重新分配源极互连的几何结构（redistributed source-interconnect geometry），同时一个协调智能体（coordinating agent）提出了一条朝衬底方向排热的路径（substrate-directed heat-removal path）。这套组合设计在金属体积固定、功耗 20 微瓦（μW）的条件下，把峰值温升（peak temperature rise）降低了 1.67 K。随后做的金属电阻灵敏度（metal-resistance sensitivity）分析，在 nFET（n 型场效应晶体管）开态电流（on-current）损失 2% 的同时，让反相器降温约 0.6 K。有效接触长度缩放（effective contact-length scaling）还进一步显示，当电流降下来时，更低的温度可以伴随着更高的热阻（thermal resistance）。复现（Reproduction）找出了结果一致的实现方案，同时保留了一个 104.95 K 的失败案例用来诊断。这些结果说明，AI 科学家工作流（AI scientist workflow）能提出热结构方案，在共同约束下测试它们，并量化它们在电学上的代价。

articles.title: An Empirical Study of Counterfactual Self-Explanations in LLMs
articles.zh: LLM 反事实自解释能力的实证研究
articles.summary: 如果你在做可解释性，或者拿 LLM 的"自我解释"当决策依据，这篇实测会提醒你别太信它
articles.author: Giannis Kalyvas, Giorgos Filandrianos 等
articles.body: Large language models can easily generate explanations for their own outputs, but such self-explanations are not necessarily faithful to the model's behavior. We study this issue through counterfactual self-explanations, where a model minimally edits an input so that its own prediction changes. Across sentiment analysis and natural language inference, we evaluate ten instruction-tuned models from the LLaMA-3 and Qwen-2.5 families, measuring faithfulness, minimality, and alignment with human-annotated rationales. Our results show that model scale is the strongest determinant of explanation quality: larger models are substantially more likely to generate counterfactuals that flip their own predictions and target decision-relevant evidence. In contrast, the rationale-guided condition produces edit-minimal counterfactuals that are also more human-aligned. However, it does not consistently improve faithfulness. Overall, counterfactual self-explanations can provide useful behavioral evidence about model decisions, but their reliability depends strongly on model capacity and should be empirically validated rather than assumed.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型（Large Language Models）特别容易给自己的输出编出一套解释，可这种自我解释（self-explanations）未必真的忠实于模型的实际行为。我们靠“反事实自我解释”（counterfactual self-explanations）来研究这件事：让模型只对输入做一点点改动，刚好让它自己的预测变掉。我们在情感分析（sentiment analysis）和自然语言推断（natural language inference）任务上，评测了 LLaMA-3 和 Qwen-2.5 系列里的十个指令微调模型（instruction-tuned models），衡量它们的忠实度（faithfulness）、改动是否最小（minimality），以及和人类标注理由（human-annotated rationales）是否对得上。结果显示，模型规模是解释质量最强的决定因素：模型越大，越可能生成那种能推翻自己原先预测、并且瞄准真正影响决策的证据的反事实解释。相比之下，在理由引导（rationale-guided）的条件下，生成的解释改动最小，也更贴近人类。但是，它并没有稳定地提高忠实度。总体来看，反事实自我解释能提供一些有用的行为证据，帮我们了解模型怎么做决定，但它可不可靠，很大程度上取决于模型能力，不能默认它靠谱，得靠实验去验证。

articles.title: Shared-Prefix KV Reuse Across Standard LoRA Adapters: Quality and Serving Tradeoffs
articles.zh: 跨标准 LoRA Adapter 的共享前缀 KV 复用：质量与推理服务的权衡
articles.summary: 如果你要同时服务多个 LoRA 微调模型、被显存和延迟卡着，这篇讲清了共享 KV 能省多少、质量又要掉多少
articles.author: Dushyant Rajput
articles.body: A common small-model deployment runs one shared backbone with several LoRA specialists that answer over the same context. Serving them naively re-prefills that shared context once per specialist. We study a narrow, practical question: for already-trained standard LoRA adapters -- not adapters retrained for cache compatibility -- how much task quality is preserved if the backbone's prefill KV cache is computed once and reused across specialists, and what does that buy in serving cost? On a Qwen3-1.7B backbone with two adapters (extractive QA on HotpotQA, arithmetic reasoning on GSM8K), we sweep the boundary at which the specialist takes over from the reused base cache and measure paired quality differences and serving cost. Full-prefix reuse had the lowest prefill cost and a small quality difference on held-out GSM8K (Delta = -4.6 EM at a 160-token budget; -3.0 at 320 tokens; -0.8 under a second training seed -- all favoring native, only the first excluding zero, and the magnitude not consistent). Partial recomputation provided no demonstrated advantage. Neither quality equivalence nor a general boundary-selection rule is established. We also report a closed-form ridge KV translator that did not beat direct reuse, and specialist-dependence contrasts whose intervals all include zero. The measured serving benefit is warm-cache time-to-first-token, which grows with context (~16x at 8K); two-branch peak memory was only 12% lower and, on inspection, the prefix was never physically shared across branches -- this implementation reuses KV values but copies their storage, so shared-cache memory savings are not achieved.
articles.bodyZh: 常见的小模型（small model）部署方式是：一个共享的主干网络（backbone）配上好几个 LoRA 专家（LoRA specialist），它们面对的是同一段上下文。如果直愣愣地拿去服务，每个专家都得把这段共享上下文重新预填充（prefill）一遍。我们要研究的其实是个很窄、但很实际的问题：对于那些已经训练好的标准 LoRA 适配器（adapter）——注意，不是专门为了兼容缓存而重训过的那种——如果主干网络的预填充 KV 缓存（KV cache）只算一次、然后让所有专家共用，任务质量还能保住多少？服务成本上又能换来什么好处？我们拿一个 Qwen3-1.7B 的主干挂了两个适配器（HotpotQA 上的抽取式问答（extractive QA），GSM8K 上的算术推理（arithmetic reasoning）），扫描了专家从复用的基础缓存那里接手的分界点，测量成对的质量差异和服务成本。结果显示，全前缀复用（full-prefix reuse）的预填充成本最低，在留出的 GSM8K 上质量差异也不大（160 token 预算下 Delta = -4.6 精确匹配（EM）；320 token 时是 -3.0；换第二个训练种子（training seed）后是 -0.8——全都是原生（native）更好，但只有第一个结果的置信区间不含零，而且幅度也不一致）。部分重算（partial recomputation）则没看出任何优势。质量是否等价、有没有通用的边界选择规则，这两点都没能站住脚。我们还报告了一个闭式岭回归 KV 转换器（closed-form ridge KV translator），结果也没能打过直接复用；另外还有专家依赖性的对比（specialist-dependence contrasts），置信区间全都包含零。实测到的服务收益是热缓存下的首 token 时延（warm-cache time-to-first-token），它会随着上下文变长而增长（8K 时大约 16 倍）；双分支的峰值内存只低了 12%，而且仔细一查发现，前缀实际上从来没有在两个分支之间物理共享——这个实现只是复用了 KV 的值，却把它们的存储复制了一份，所以共享缓存本该省下的内存并没有省下来。

articles.title: Symbolic Separation: Grounding Deep Agents in Knowledge Graphs for Trustworthy Operational Data Analytics
articles.zh: 符号分离：把深度 Agent 锚定在知识图谱中，实现可信的运营数据分析
articles.summary: 如果你在企业里做 Agent 又怕它张口就编，这套用知识图谱约束推理的思路值得抄
articles.author: Baibek Davletiyarov, Junaid Ahmed Khan 等
articles.body: Generative AI promises natural language access to the massive numerical telemetry of data centers and Industry 4.0 installations, yet text-to-query and tool-using agents stay unreliable: even frontier models answer little more than half of real-world database questions, and far fewer of the multi-step, operational ones, because the LLM must compose how heterogeneous sources relate and hallucinates the relations, not just the fields. We propose symbolic separation: a deep agent reasons freely but may act on data only through an ontology-constrained Virtual Knowledge Graph with deterministic pre-execution validation. Unlike a tool API's interface contract, this domain-semantic contract turns a complex question into one validated graph traversal instead of LLM-inferred joins. Instantiated as the Neurosymbolic Deep Analyst and evaluated on 49.9 TB of superconputer telemetry against a rigid workflow and a non-symbolic ablation, it raises end-to-end task success from 43% to 86%, prevents silent data-integrity errors that no syntactic check catches, and cuts token cost by 2.4x, letting a smaller on-premise model outperform a larger one.
articles.bodyZh: 生成式AI（Generative AI）号称能用大白话直接查询数据中心和工业4.0设施里海量的数值遥测数据，但现实很骨感：文本转查询和工具调用型智能体还是不太靠谱。即便是最顶尖的模型，面对真实世界的数据库问题，答对率也就一半出头，涉及多步骤的操作类问题就更惨了。为啥？因为大语言模型（LLM）得自己琢磨不同数据源之间是怎么关联的，结果就是瞎编——不光是字段编，连表与表之间的关系都能给你编出来。我们提出了一个思路叫“符号分离”：让一个深度智能体自由推理，但它想碰数据，必须通过一个受本体约束的虚拟知识图谱（Virtual Knowledge Graph），而且执行前有确定性的校验。跟工具API那种接口契约不一样，这种领域语义契约能把一个复杂问题直接变成一次经过验证的图遍历，而不是让LLM去猜怎么join。我们把它落地成了一个叫“神经符号深度分析师”（Neurosymbolic Deep Analyst）的系统，在49.9 TB的超算遥测数据上做了评测，跟一个固定工作流和一个非符号化的消融版本对比，结果端到端任务成功率从43%干到了86%，还能拦住那些语法检查根本发现不了的静默数据完整性错误，同时token开销砍了2.4倍——一个更小的本地部署模型反而跑赢了更大的模型。

articles.title: Semi-Supervised Learning-Based Genetic Biomarkers Dataset for Multiple-Stage Hepatocellular Carcinoma Prediction
articles.zh: 基于半监督学习的多阶段肝细胞癌预测基因生物标志物数据集
articles.summary: 如果你做医学 AI 或生物标志物筛选，这个半监督构建的多阶段肝癌数据集可以直接拿来跑基线
articles.author: Ahmed Ammar Kubba, Manar Abu Talib 等
articles.body: Liver cancer is a complex disease responsible for a high number of deaths across the globe each year, making automated solutions for liver cancer classification urgent. The most common form of liver cancer is hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), accounting for over 90% of liver cancer cases. There is a distinct lack of publicly available HCC datasets utilizing genomic data, which is necessary for training artificial intelligence (AI) models for automated HCC classification. This study proposes constructing a multi-stage HCC dataset using XGBoost and Semi-Supervised learning on three separate datasets of genomic biomarkers, utilizing their existing labels in the Semi-Supervised learning process to label the proposed dataset. The proposed dataset consists of 770 patient samples in total, categorized into five classes that represent normal tissue alongside different stages of HCC. Each sample in the dataset consists of 11,150 different gene expression levels. The XGBoost model demonstrated a final classification accuracy of 96.5% during the Semi-Supervised learning process.
articles.bodyZh: 肝癌（liver cancer）是一种很复杂的疾病，每年在全球都会夺走很多人的生命，所以用自动化方案来做肝癌分类，已经成了当务之急。最常见的肝癌类型是肝细胞癌（hepatocellular carcinoma, HCC），它占了所有肝癌病例的 90% 以上。可现在公开可用、又能拿来训练人工智能（AI）模型做自动 HCC 分类的 HCC 基因组数据（genomic data）数据集（dataset），明显少得可怜。这项研究提出，要在三个独立的基因组生物标志物（genomic biomarkers）数据集上，用 XGBoost 和半监督学习（Semi-Supervised learning）来构建一个多阶段（multi-stage）HCC 数据集，并在半监督学习过程中利用这些数据原本就有的标签（labels），给这个新提出的数据集打标签。这个新数据集总共包含 770 个患者样本，分成五类，分别代表正常组织以及 HCC 的不同阶段。数据集里的每个样本，都包含 11,150 个不同的基因表达水平（gene expression levels）。在半监督学习过程中，XGBoost 模型最终做到的分类准确率（classification accuracy）是 96.5%。

articles.title: Scaling-Score Conformal Prediction for Multi-Target Regression
articles.zh: 面向多目标回归的 Scaling-Score Conformal Prediction
articles.summary: 如果你需要给多目标回归模型输出带置信度的预测区间，这个方法比传统 conformal 更适配
articles.author: Sylvain Rousseau, Soundouss Messoudi
articles.body: Multi-target regression requires a model to simultaneously predict several related outputs. Conformal prediction provides distribution-free, finite-sample marginal coverage guarantees, but extending these to joint multi-dimensional regions in a model-agnostic, sample-efficient manner remains challenging: max-aggregation ignores scale differences, copula-based methods are only asymptotically valid, rectangular methods typically split the calibration set, and quantile or density-based methods require training a specialised model beyond a plain point predictor. We propose the scaling-score conformal method, which is model-agnostic (requires only component-wise absolute residuals), uses a single calibration set, and yields four nested output types: an outer rectangle (SCO) with valid joint coverage, the exact set R $α$ , a staircase (SC 2 ) over approximation of R $α$ , and an inner rectangle (SCI). A single hyperparameter $γ$ $\in$ (0, 1) controls the base-rectangle quantile level independently of $α$. We prove downward-closedness and a rectangular sandwich bound and derive a closed-form outer rectangle. Experiments on 29 realworld datasets confirm valid joint coverage; SC 2 with $γ$ = 1-$α$ consistently achieves competitive volume relative to baselines, with the advantage growing with output dimension d.
articles.bodyZh: 多目标回归（multi-target regression）要求模型同时预测好几个彼此相关的输出。共形预测（conformal prediction）能提供不依赖分布、在有限样本（finite-sample）下也成立的边际覆盖（marginal coverage）保证，但想把它扩展到联合多维区域（joint multi-dimensional regions），还要做到不挑模型（model-agnostic）、又省样本（sample-efficient），仍然很难：最大值聚合（max-aggregation）会忽略不同输出之间的尺度差异；基于 copula 的方法（copula-based methods）只在渐近意义下有效（asymptotically valid）；矩形方法（rectangular methods）通常要把校准集（calibration set）拆开；而基于分位数或密度的方法（quantile or density-based methods），除了普通点预测器（point predictor）之外，还得再训一个专门模型。我们提出缩放分数共形方法（scaling-score conformal method），它不挑模型——只需要逐分量的绝对残差（component-wise absolute residuals）——而且只用一套校准集（single calibration set），最后给出四种嵌套的输出类型（nested output types）：一个带有效联合覆盖（valid joint coverage）的外层矩形（SCO）、精确集合 R_α、R_α 的阶梯形过近似（over-approximation，SC2），以及一个内层矩形（SCI）。用一个超参数 γ ∈ (0,1) 就能控制基础矩形的分位数水平（base-rectangle quantile level），而且它和 α 相互独立。我们证明了向下封闭性（downward-closedness）和矩形夹逼界（rectangular sandwich bound），并推导出一个闭式外层矩形（closed-form outer rectangle）。在 29 个真实世界数据集（real-world datasets）上的实验证实了联合覆盖是有效的；当 γ = 1-α 时，SC2 相对于各基线（baselines）能稳定取得有竞争力的体积（volume），而且输出维度 d 越大，这个优势越明显。

articles.title: Interactive Memory Learning for Long-Term Conversations
articles.zh: 面向长期对话的交互式记忆学习
articles.summary: 如果你在做陪伴类或长期记忆型对话产品，这篇讲的是怎么让模型在交互过程中主动学记忆，而不是只靠外挂检索
articles.author: Cai Ke, Jiangyue Yan 等
articles.body: Recent advancements in large language models have significantly enhanced the capabilities of agents in modeling long-term conversations. Despite these successes, existing approaches typically adopt a static heuristic paradigm, where information is passively archived without adaptive memory valuation. Consequently, these methods fail to self-evolve or align their memory management with evolving user needs. To address this, we propose ICML (InteraCtive Memory Learning), a multi-agent framework that transforms the memory mechanism from a passive archive into a learnable, interactive memory policy. Specifically, we first employ a session synthesis pipeline to generate expert data, facilitating rapid test-time adaptation in unseen scenarios. Building on this, ICML utilizes an online reinforcement learning mechanism where a Planner agent selectively encodes high-value information and a Trigger agent dynamically retrieves it to optimize response quality, whereby the two agents co-evolve through continuous interaction feedback. Crucially, both agents are synchronized through a delayed reward mechanism that propagates future feedback back to earlier storage decisions, ensuring memory policies are precisely aligned with user expectations. Experimental results demonstrate that ICML significantly outperforms strong baselines, exhibiting the unique capability to continuously improve response quality as interactions accumulate.
articles.bodyZh: 最近，大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）的进步，让智能体（agents）在长期对话建模上的能力明显强了不少。可即便这么厉害，现有做法大多还是走一套固定的启发式范式（static heuristic paradigm）：信息只是被被动存下来，并不会根据价值自适应地做记忆估值（adaptive memory valuation）。结果就是，这些方法没法自我演化，也没法让自己的记忆管理跟着用户不断变化的需求走。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 ICML（InteraCtive Memory Learning，交互式记忆学习），这是一个多智能体框架（multi-agent framework），它把记忆机制从“被动存档”变成了可学习、可交互的记忆策略（memory policy）。具体来说，我们先用一个会话合成流水线（session synthesis pipeline）来生成专家数据，这样在没见过的场景里也能快速做测试时适应（test-time adaptation）。在此基础上，ICML 用了一套在线强化学习（online reinforcement learning）机制：规划智能体（Planner agent）会挑出高价值信息来编码，触发智能体（Trigger agent）则动态把它们检索出来，以此优化回复质量；这两个智能体靠不断互动的反馈一起演化。关键是，两个智能体还通过一个延迟奖励机制（delayed reward mechanism）保持同步，把未来的反馈一路传回给更早的存储决策，确保记忆策略跟用户预期精准对齐。实验结果表明，ICML 明显甩开了一堆强基线（strong baselines），还展现出一种特别的能力：随着互动越来越多，回复质量能持续变好。
